name: Customer Support Console
shortDescription: Customer lookup, subscription context, tickets and escalation in one console.
longDescription: A full support workspace: customer and subscription lookup, payment history, ticket intake, assignment, SLA tracking, escalation workflows, canned replies, CSAT and an admin panel for users, roles, audit, imports, integrations and data quality.
author: Jet Admin
features: Seeded, domain-specific data model with audit triggers
Parameterized SQL queries with server-side pagination and CSV export
Role-aware pages and Casbin asset permissions
Workflow automations for intake, approvals, assignments and SLA sweeps
In-app notification center, comments, attachments and saved views
Admin screens for users, roles, audit, operations and data quality

requiredIntegrations.title: SendGrid email

workflows.title: Tickets · intake triage
workflows.description: Loads a record, computes a deterministic risk/priority score, then routes to review or standard triage and notifies the owner.

workflows.title: Tickets · round-robin assignment
workflows.description: Picks the least-loaded active staff member and assigns the record, then sends an in-app notification.

workflows.title: Tickets · approval chain
workflows.description: Human approval with timeout, rejection and expiry paths. Approved records move to the next stage; every path notifies the owner.

workflows.title: Tickets · threshold sweep
workflows.description: Finds overdue records, iterates with a bounded loop and sends an in-app reminder for each one.

workflows.title: Tickets · daily digest
workflows.description: Builds a daily summary and writes a single in-app notification.

workflows.title: Tickets · escalation
workflows.description: Waits for a configurable delay, then escalates high-priority records and notifies the manager.

workflows.title: Customer Support Console · integration sync
workflows.description: Calls the mock REST integration, normalizes the response and recovers through an explicit error path. The default endpoint is intentionally unreachable.

workflows.title: Tickets · document generation
workflows.description: Builds an HTML document from record fields, links it as an attachment and notifies the owner.

workflows.title: Tickets · supplier/customer follow-up
workflows.description: Suspends for a structured follow-up form, then records the answer as a comment.

workflows.title: Customer Support Console · expected failure and recovery
workflows.description: Injects a bounded failure, follows the error edge and confirms the compensation path with a notification.

workflows.title: Customer Support Console · notify only
workflows.description: Minimal workflow used by inbound webhooks and manual demos: writes one notification.
